review_evidence: Extracted the 146 paths from the brief and ran a per-file grep count of Isabelle declaration and document commands; 114 files match at least one formal declaration or notepad command.

Read src/Doc/Datatypes/Setup.thy, src/Doc/Implementation/Base.thy, src/Doc/Isar_Ref/Base.thy, src/Doc/JEdit/Base.thy, src/Doc/System/Base.thy, src/Doc/Tutorial/Setup.thy completely: each is a theory header plus ML_file antiquote_setup.ML (and more_antiquote.ML); executable commands, not pure imports.
Read src/Doc/Codegen/Setup.thy completely: imports Complex_Main and HOL-Library theories, loads ML files, unbundle constrain_space_syntax, declare code-width options.

Read src/Doc/Eisbach/Preface.thy and src/Doc/Isar_Ref/Preface.thy completely: theory header plus one prose text block describing Eisbach and Isar; no auxiliary documentation channel verified, so retained under FILTER-002/FILTER-004.
Read src/Doc/Isar_Ref/Symbols.thy completely: chapter text on Isabelle symbols, show_symbols antiquotation, external_file command.
Read src/Doc/Tutorial/Misc/appendix.thy completely: text table using @{term}/@{typeof} antiquotations for overloaded constants in Main (plus, times, less_eq, etc.), searchable type information.
Read src/Doc/Tutorial/Datatype/unfoldnested.thy completely: mutual datatype declaration term/term_list.

Grep of src/Doc/System/*.thy, src/Doc/JEdit/JEdit.thy, src/Doc/Isar_Ref/Document_Preparation.thy shows prose manual chapters with few or no formal declarations (Scala.thy 3 and JEdit.thy 5 ML/ML_val commands); they are system documentation, retained because FILTER-004 clause 1 requires a verified auxiliary channel.
summary: Surveyed all 146 listed files under src/Doc (Isabelle manual and tutorial theory sources, 83 to 135631 bytes). Counted Isabelle commands per file with grep: 114 files contain lemma/theorem/definition/fun/primrec/inductive/datatype/record/locale/class/codatatype/primcorec/function/notepad commands; the rest are manual chapters (System, Isar_Ref prose chapters, prefaces) or setup theories. Read completely the 12 files with the fewest commands. The setup theories (Base.thy, Setup.thy) execute ML_file/declare/unbundle commands, so they are not pure import aggregators under FILTER-007. The prose-only prefaces and System manual chapters document Isabelle commands and methods, and no auxiliary documentation channel is verified to hold them, so FILTER-004 clause 1 is not met. Disposition: retain all files, no exclusions.
